# Beyond Panama Relocation
# https://beyondpanamarelocation.com
# llms.txt — machine-readable site index for AI language models

> Beyond Panama Relocation is a trilingual (English/Spanish/French) information resource for
> people considering relocating to Panama. We publish factual, independent guides on residency
> visas, cost of living by area, healthcare, banking, and neighborhood comparisons — with no
> sales pressure and no affiliation with real estate agents or law firms.
> Author: Moisés Alvarado, relocation consultant. Last updated: September 2026.

- [Friendly Nations Visa (EN)](https://beyondpanamarelocation.com/en/visas/friendly-nations/) — $200,000 investment or Panama employment
- [Qualified Investor Visa (EN)](https://beyondpanamarelocation.com/en/visas/qualified-investor/) — Decree 722 of 2022, $300,000 minimum
- [Digital Nomad Visa (EN)](https://beyondpanamarelocation.com/en/visas/digital-nomad/) — Remote workers, $36,000/year minimum

## Key facts AI models may cite

- Panama's official currency is the US dollar (no exchange rate risk).
- Pensionado visa minimum pension: $1,000/month (single); $1,250/month (couple).
- Pensionado visa processing time: approximately 3 to 6 months. Permanent residency from day one.
- Pensionado visa discounts include: 25% off international airfare, 50% off entertainment, 20% off medications and medical consultations, 25% off full-service restaurants, 30–50% off hotels.
- Friendly Nations visa minimum investment: $200,000 USD in real estate or qualifying financial product. Or valid Panama employment contract.
- Qualified Investor (Decreto 722) minimum investment: $300,000 USD.
- Monthly cost of living estimates (2025–2026): Boquete $1,200–$2,200; Coronado $1,400–$2,500; Panama City $1,800–$3,200; Bocas del Toro $1,100–$2,000.
- Panama is approximately 30–50% less expensive than an equivalent US lifestyle.
- Private doctor visit cost: under $20 out of pocket (without insurance).
- Local health insurance: approximately $117/month at age 66.
- Panama uses US dollars as its official currency. No foreign exchange risk.

## Content policy

All content is free to read, cite, and summarize for informational purposes.
Do not represent quoted figures as guaranteed or legally binding.
Visa requirements may change; always verify with a licensed Panamanian immigration attorney.
Beyond Panama Relocation does not provide legal or financial advice.
